title: TABular Semantic Enhancement Blueprint (TAB-SEB)
author: Arianna Moretti
materials: RDF graph generation from curated data

steps.title: Gather or Select Dataset
steps.instruction: Acquire the necessary data for the process.

substeps.instruction: Gather data if the dataset needs to be created from scratch.
If multiple access approaches are provided by a data source, select the dataset.
Extract data and produce a sample dataset for explorative purposes, utilizing monitoring and automated tests.
Perform human inspection of the sample dataset and provide feedback to identify harmonisation needs.

steps.title: Identify Legal and Ethical Constraints
steps.instruction: Identify the legal and ethical constraints regarding the reuse of the collected data.

steps.title: Execute invalid_dois_main Function
steps.instruction: Launch the code from the command prompt by calling the main function 'invalid_dois_main' with three required parameters.

substeps.instruction: Provide an integer number to define the frequency (number of processed lines) at which obtained data are saved to cache files.
Provide an input CSV file containing two columns: 'Valid_citing_DOI' (citing identifiers) and 'Invalid_cited_DOI' (addressed DOIs).
Provide an output JSON file path where processed data will be saved at the end of the process.

steps.title: Publish RDF Serialisation
steps.instruction: Publish the RDF serialisation (e.g., TTL) citable release through FAIR-compliant platforms.

steps.title: Integrate Provenance and Change Tracking
steps.instruction: Integrate a provenance management and change tracking approach.

steps.title: Configure Semantic Access Layer
steps.instruction: Configure and publish a semantic access layer for data dissemination (e.g., a web portal) to enable data access for experts and general users.

steps.title: Plan for Reiteration
steps.instruction: Plan for reiteration in the event of data updates or refinement necessities.
